project.description: Tenant build-out of a ground floor storefront as a small cafe in an existing mixed-use building. Zoning district B3-2. Standard Plan Review.
project.reviewer: Department of Buildings, first review cycle

comments.heading: Zoning
comments.text: The new canopy projects over the sidewalk. A public way use permit from the Department of Transportation is needed for this projection.

comments.heading: Building
comments.text: The existing step at the main entrance is shown to remain. Show the accessible route into the space.

comments.heading: Building
comments.text: Per 13-160, the rear exit door is drawn swinging against the direction of egress. Correct the swing on the plan and the door schedule.

comments.heading: Building
comments.text: The occupant load calculation is not on the floor plan.

comments.heading: Mechanical
comments.text: The kitchen exhaust hood on the mechanical plan is not coordinated with the equipment layout. Provide the exhaust design.

comments.heading: General
comments.text: The title block on M-101 shows a former project address. Correct the title block.

expected.why: The Department of Transportation issues this. It is an encroachment into the public way.
How the route works at an existing step is a design and code judgment.
Title 13 was replaced. Both the plan and the schedule change, as the comment says.
The occupant load is the architect's calculation. Don't supply a number.
Clerical title block fix, but still a sheet revision and marked like one.
